en: We figure the interest charge on your account by applying the periodic rate to the "adjusted balance" of your account. We get the "adjusted balance" by taking the balance you owed at the end of the previous billing cycle and subtracting any payments and credits received during the present billing cycle.
zh: 我们将周期利率乘以您账户的「调整后余额」来计算利息费用。「调整后余额」的算法是：取您上一个账单周期结束时的欠款余额，再减去本账单周期内收到的所有还款和入账金额。

en: We figure the interest charge on your account by applying the periodic rate to the amount you owe at the beginning of each billing cycle. We do not subtract any payments or credits received during the billing cycle.
zh: 我们将周期利率乘以您在每个账单周期开始时的欠款金额来计算利息费用。本周期内收到的还款和入账金额一律不予扣除。

en: To get the "average daily balance" we take the beginning balance of your account each day and subtract any payments or credits. We do not add in any new purchases, advances, or fees. This gives us the daily balance. Then, we add all the daily balances for the billing cycle together and divide the total by the number of days in the billing cycle.
zh: 「平均每日余额」的算法是：取您账户每天的期初余额，减去还款和入账金额，不计入任何新的消费、预借现金或费用，得出当日余额。然后把该账单周期内所有的每日余额相加，除以该周期的天数。

en: We figure the interest charge on your account by applying the periodic rate to the amount you owe at the end of each billing cycle, including new purchases and deducting payments and credits made during the billing cycle.
zh: 我们将周期利率乘以您在每个账单周期结束时的欠款金额来计算利息费用，其中包含本周期内的新增消费，并已扣除本周期内的还款和入账金额。

en: We figure the interest charge on your account by applying the periodic rate to the "daily balance" of your account for each day in the billing cycle. To get the "daily balance" we take the beginning balance of your account each day, add any new purchases, advances, or fees, and subtract any unpaid interest or other finance charges and any payments or credits.
zh: 我们将周期利率乘以账单周期内每一天的「每日余额」来计算利息费用。「每日余额」的算法是：取您账户每天的期初余额，加上当日新增的消费、预借现金或费用，再减去未付利息、其他财务费用，以及还款和入账金额。

en: If you notice the loss or theft of your credit card or a possible unauthorized use of your card, you should write to us immediately at the address listed on your bill, or call us at the number provided.
zh: 如果您发现信用卡遗失、被盗，或者卡片可能遭到未经授权的使用，请立即按账单上列明的地址写信通知我们，或拨打所提供的电话与我们联系。

en: You will not be liable for any unauthorized use that occurs after you notify us. You may, however, be liable for unauthorized use that occurs before your notice to us. In any case, your liability will not exceed $50.
zh: 在您通知我们之后发生的任何未经授权的使用，您无需承担责任。但在您通知我们之前发生的未经授权的使用，您可能需要承担责任。无论何种情况，您承担的责任上限均为 50 美元。

en: This notice contains important information about your rights and our responsibilities under the Fair Credit Billing Act. Keep this notice for future use.
zh: 本通知载有重要信息，说明您在《公平信用账单法》下享有的权利以及我们所承担的责任。请妥善保存本通知，以备日后查阅。

en: If you think your bill is wrong, or if you need more information about a transaction on your bill, write to us at the address listed on your bill as soon as possible. We must hear from you no later than 60 days after we sent you the first bill on which the error or problem appeared. You can telephone us, but doing so will not preserve your rights.
zh: 如果您认为账单有误，或者需要了解账单上某笔交易的更多信息，请尽快按账单上列明的地址写信给我们。我们必须在您收到首份出现该错误或问题的账单之日起 60 天内收到您的来信。您也可以致电我们，但致电不能保留您的权利。

en: In your letter, give us the following information: your name and account number; the dollar amount of the suspected error; and describe the error and explain, if you can, why you believe there is an error.
zh: 请在信中提供以下信息：您的姓名和账号；您认为出错的具体金额；以及对该错误的描述，如果可以的话，请说明您认为存在错误的理由。

en: If you have authorized us to pay your credit card bill automatically from your savings or checking account, you can stop the payment on any amount you think is wrong. To stop the payment your letter must reach us 3 business days before the automatic payment is scheduled to occur.
zh: 如果您已授权我们从您的储蓄账户或支票账户自动支付信用卡账单，您可以就任何您认为有误的金额停止付款。若要停止付款，您的来信必须在预定自动扣款日之前 3 个工作日送达我们。

en: When we receive your letter, we must do two things. First, within 30 days of receiving your letter, we must tell you that we received your letter. Second, within 90 days, we must either correct the error or explain to you why we believe the bill is correct.
zh: 我们收到您的来信后，必须做两件事。第一，在收到来信之日起 30 天内，我们必须告知您已收到来信。第二，在 90 天内，我们必须更正该错误，或者向您说明我们认为账单无误的理由。

en: While we investigate whether or not there has been an error, we cannot try to collect the amount in question, or report you as delinquent on that amount. The charge in question may remain on your statement, and we may continue to charge you interest on that amount. While you do not have to pay the amount in question, you are responsible for the remainder of your balance.
zh: 在我们调查是否存在错误期间，我们不得就争议金额向您催收，也不得就该笔金额将您记录为逾期。该笔争议交易可能仍会显示在您的对账单上，我们也可能继续就该金额计收利息。虽然您无需支付争议金额，但您仍须对余下的欠款负责。

en: After we finish our investigation, one of two things will happen. If we made a mistake, you will not have to pay the amount in question or any interest or other fees related to that amount. If we do not believe there was a mistake, you will have to pay the amount in question, along with applicable interest and fees.
zh: 调查结束后会有两种结果。如果确实是我们的失误，您无需支付该笔争议金额，也无需支付与之相关的任何利息或其他费用。如果我们认为并不存在错误，您则须支付该笔争议金额，以及相应的利息和费用。

en: If you receive our explanation but still believe your bill is wrong, you must write to us within 10 days telling us that you still refuse to pay. If you do so, we cannot report you as delinquent without also reporting that you are questioning your bill. We must tell you the name of anyone to whom we reported you as delinquent.
zh: 如果您收到我们的说明后仍认为账单有误，您必须在 10 天内写信告知我们您仍拒绝付款。若您这样做，我们在将您记录为逾期时，必须同时注明您对该账单存有异议。我们也必须告知您，我们向哪些机构报告了您的逾期记录。

en: If we do not follow all of the rules above, you do not have to pay the first $50 of the amount you question even if your bill is correct.
zh: 如果我们未能遵守上述全部规定，即使您的账单本身无误，您也无需支付争议金额中的头 50 美元。

en: If you are dissatisfied with the goods or services that you have purchased with your credit card, and you have tried in good faith to correct the problem with the merchant, you may have the right not to pay the remaining amount due on the purchase.
zh: 如果您对使用信用卡购买的商品或服务不满意，并且已经善意地尝试与商家解决该问题，您可能有权不再支付该笔消费的剩余欠款。

en: To use this right, all of the following must be true. The purchase must have been made in your home state or within 100 miles of your current mailing address, and the purchase price must have been more than $50. Neither of these is necessary if your purchase was based on an advertisement we mailed to you, or if we own the company that sold you the goods or services.
zh: 要行使这项权利，以下条件必须全部满足。该笔消费必须发生在您所居住的州境内，或者在您当前邮寄地址 100 英里的范围内，并且消费金额必须超过 50 美元。但如果该笔消费是基于我们邮寄给您的广告而发生的，或者销售该商品或服务的公司为我们所有，则上述两项条件均无需满足。

en: You must have used your credit card for the purchase. Purchases made with cash advances from an ATM or with a check that accesses your credit card account do not qualify. You must not yet have fully paid for the purchase.
zh: 该笔消费必须是使用信用卡支付的。通过 ATM 预借现金，或使用可动用信用卡账户的支票所进行的消费，均不符合条件。此外，您对该笔消费尚未全额付清。

en: Unless you tell us otherwise, we will decline any transaction that causes you to go over your credit limit. If you want us to authorize these transactions, you can request over-the-credit limit coverage.
zh: 除非您另行告知，否则凡是会导致您超出信用额度的交易，我们一律拒绝授权。如果您希望我们为这类交易授权，可以申请开通超限额度服务。

en: If you have over-the-credit limit coverage and you go over your credit limit, we will charge you a fee of up to $35. We may also increase your APRs to the Penalty APR. You will only pay one fee per billing cycle, even if you go over your limit multiple times in the same cycle.
zh: 如果您已开通超限额度服务并且实际超出了信用额度，我们将收取最高 35 美元的费用，同时可能将您的年利率上调至罚息年利率。即使您在同一个账单周期内多次超限，也只收取一次费用。

en: Even if you request over-the-credit limit coverage, in some cases we may still decline a transaction that would cause you to go over your limit, such as if you are past due or significantly over your credit limit.
zh: 即使您已申请开通超限额度服务，在某些情况下我们仍可能拒绝会导致您超限的交易，例如您已经逾期，或者已经大幅超出信用额度。

en: You currently have over-the-credit limit coverage on your account, which means that we pay transactions that cause you to go over your credit limit. To remove over-the-credit-limit coverage from your account, call us at the number on the back of your card or visit our website.
zh: 您的账户目前已开通超限额度服务，也就是说，会导致您超出信用额度的交易我们仍会照付。如需取消该服务，请拨打卡背面的电话，或访问我们的网站。

en: Late Payment Warning: If we do not receive your minimum payment by the date listed above, you may have to pay a $35 late fee and your APRs may be increased up to the Penalty APR of 28.99%.
zh: 逾期还款提示：如果我们未在上述日期前收到您的最低还款额，您可能需要支付 35 美元的滞纳金，并且您的年利率可能被上调至 28.99% 的罚息年利率。

en: You must pay your promotional balance in full by the date shown to avoid paying accrued interest charges.
zh: 您必须在所示日期之前全额付清优惠期内的欠款余额，才能免于支付已累计的利息费用。

en: Interest will be charged to your account from the purchase date if the purchase balance is not paid in full within the deferred interest period, or if you make a late payment.
zh: 如果您未在延期计息期内全额付清该笔消费的欠款，或者出现逾期还款，我们将从消费当日起对您的账户计收利息。

en: I understand that enrollment is not required to obtain credit. I also understand that depending on the event, the protection may only temporarily suspend my duty to make minimum payments, not reduce the balance I owe. I understand that my balance will actually grow during the suspension period as interest continues to accumulate.
zh: 本人理解，参加本项目并非获得信贷的必要条件。本人也理解，视触发事件而定，该保障可能只是暂时中止本人支付最低还款额的义务，并不会减少本人的欠款余额。本人理解，在中止期间利息将持续累计，本人的欠款余额实际上还会增加。

en: The credit card account you have with us is insured. This is to notify you that we plan to replace your current coverage with insurance coverage from a different insurer. If we obtain insurance for your account from a different insurer, you may cancel the insurance.
zh: 您在我行的信用卡账户已投保。现通知您，我们计划将您目前的保障更换为另一家保险公司提供的保险保障。如果我们为您的账户改由另一家保险公司承保，您可以选择取消该保险。

en: Your coverage will be affected by the following: the elimination of a type of coverage previously provided to you; a decrease in your maximum insurable balance or maximum periodic benefit payment; a restriction in the definition of disability or other key term of coverage; or an increase in the elimination or waiting period.
zh: 您的保障将受到以下变动的影响：取消原先向您提供的某一类保障；下调可投保余额上限或每期给付上限；收紧「伤残」或其他关键条款的定义；或者延长免责期，也就是等待期。

en: The information about the costs of the card described in this application is accurate as of the date shown. This information may have changed after that date. To find out what may have changed, call us or write to us at the address provided.
zh: 本申请表中所述的用卡费用信息，截至所示日期为准确信息。该日期之后信息可能已有变动。如需了解具体变动内容，请致电我们，或按所提供的地址来函咨询。
